data.body: Plan revised after certified review run 4. It applies 4 advisories: (1) the ADR Follow-up no longer says only S1-S3 delivered the implementation, and now credits the epic's child stories; (2) the I1 cross-reference uses the target paragraphs' exact titles; (3) the scope proof diffs against the merge-base and names the old-side hunk start; (4) 'I1 contains X' is defined as a single-quoted fixed-string grep. I re-ran every AC proof on a scratch copy of 9d10232dd89 with the exact new text, and all pass. I left one advisory as is: 'committed exactly as written'. A substring AC set cannot prove a verbatim match, and the diff itself is the reviewer's check.
